hero.title: About Dori & Rito
hero.subtitle: We're a KPA and CATCH certified positive-training team who believes every dog deserves to be understood — not just commanded.

mission.title: Our Philosophy
mission.p1: We believe dog training should never rely on punishment or fear. Lasting behaviour change happens when dogs can actively choose the right behaviour in a positive, safe environment.
mission.p2: Using scientifically validated positive reinforcement, we don't just help your dog change — we help you understand your dog, and build a bond that runs deeper than compliance.

trainerProfiles.name: Pennee
trainerProfiles.title: KPA Certified Training Partner
certifications: KPA CTP (Karen Pryor Academy Certified Training Partner)
trainerProfiles.specialty: Separation anxiety, puppy education, multi-dog households
trainerProfiles.bio: With years of hands-on positive training experience, Pennee specialises in highly sensitive dogs and separation anxiety cases. She believes every dog is capable of learning — and every behaviour has a reason behind it.

trainerProfiles.name: Eric
trainerProfiles.title: KPA Certified Training Partner
certifications: KPA CTP (Karen Pryor Academy Certified Training Partner)
trainerProfiles.specialty: Reactive dogs, leash pulling, foundation training
trainerProfiles.bio: Eric focuses on helping reactive and leash-reactive dogs. Through scientifically grounded positive reinforcement, he creates a relaxed, joyful learning environment where dogs can genuinely thrive.
